name: Porto Calvo (Brazil)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and green charged with three overlapping yellow cogwheels: the outer two bearing a stalk of sugar cane and a head of wheat, the central one a blue disc with red hills and a white branching river.
history: Porto Calvo is a municipality in the state of Alagoas, Brazil. Portuguese Wikipedia records that the flag was created on 7 September 1978 by Isaías Soares da Silva: the green stands for the forests, the white for peace, the blue for the sky and the red for the blood of the battles fought there.

features.role: three overlapping cogwheels with sugar cane, wheat and a landscape
